profile.headline: Software Engineer | MS Computer Science, AI/ML | Full-Stack, WebRTC, Cloud Infra
profile.summary:
Hi there! My name is Derek Nguyen. I'm a software engineer at ScreenBeam with a Master's in Computer Science (Machine Learning) from USC. For the past two years I've worked across the stack: backend REST APIs in Python and C++, PostgreSQL and Redis performance work, Docker CI/CD pipelines, a Selenium regression framework, and a low-latency iOS casting app in Swift using WebRTC.

My ML background has turned into hands-on work with AI agents. At ScreenBeam I built a LangGraph agent that ranks vulnerabilities across our repos by LLM-checked reachability. I've also built a multi-agent coordination system on MCP, with an evaluation harness and a verification loop that raised the eval pass rate from 20% to 80%. 

I built a real-time messaging API with ASP.NET Core, Azure Cosmos DB and Service Bus, deployed to Kubernetes.

I'm looking for roles in backend systems, developer tooling, or AI agent infrastructure. Feel free to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core engineer on BrowserCast, ScreenBeam's multi-platform screen-casting application for education, spanning iOS, Android, and a Node.js backend with real-time media delivery over WebRTC. I own features end to end from mobile clients to backend and deployment infrastructure, working across firmware, QA, and product teams to ship releases on three platforms.
 
• Built a read-only security agent (Python, LangGraph) that scans 5 repositories monthly and ranks vulnerabilities by exploit risk using LLM reachability checks
• Build and maintain WebRTC media pipelines across iOS, Android, and web, shipping features from mobile capture through backend signaling and delivery
• Led glass-to-glass latency measurement and optimization for live screen casting, establishing a repeatable benchmarking methodology against a 200ms latency target
• Prototyped a high-availability caching layer with Redis and C++, benchmarking 60% lower database load and documenting the tradeoffs against query-side optimization
• Architected backend REST APIs for authentication, user management, and device communication, and optimized PostgreSQL with connection pooling and lock-free queues, cutting API response time by 40%
• Architected a parallel automated testing framework using Selenium and network discovery protocols to test Chromium extensions across fleets of physical devices, reducing QA bug detection time by 75%
• Built a Chrome extension with web filtering across 35,000+ URLs, including wildcard domain blocking and custom rules, driving a 15% increase in subscriptions
• Built CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions with Dockerized build and test environments, automating releases across iOS, Android, and backend services and cutting feature release time by 25%
• Worked with DevOps to provision AWS infrastructure with Terraform and migrate frontend hosting to S3 + CloudFront

projects.title: CurfewBot for Discord Servers
projects.description: Discord bot enforcing user-set curfews by removing and blocking members from voice channels until their curfew ends, with automated warnings and public call-outs in text channels.

projects.title: Empathetic Conversational LM
projects.description: Developed and fine-tuned two DialoGPT variants for emotional support conversations, using maximum likelihood and RL-based (PPO) objectives with KL-divergence reward shaping. Curated two therapeutic-dialogue datasets, improving model consistency by 88% and achieving a 25% reduction in perplexity and 15% increase in BLEU score over baseline. Published as a research paper.
